findings.title: IX05 can strand a reachable release attempt in failure cleanup, so accepted whole-work cancellation has no parent-terminal continuation
findings.requirement: Every reachable nonterminal improvement tuple accepts IX01, and cancellation must settle its attempt/effects/rollback/cleanup before IX04 alone reaches parent CANCELLED.

adversarial_trace: Reach an exact IA07-* or IA08-* failure tuple. The synchronized row leaves the candidate failed, release_attempt_state=FAILURE_PENDING_CLEANUP, a CleanupManifest present, and the parent canonical CLEANING.
Before IA16, accept authenticated cancellation through IX01, which is promised for every reachable nonterminal tuple. The work cancellation coordinate becomes REQUESTED.

Take IX05 because the pre-cancel canonical state was CLEANING and the named stop/effect/rollback predicates are settled. The work cancellation coordinate becomes CLEANING, but the release attempt remains FAILURE_PENDING_CLEANUP.

IA09-IA12 cannot apply from FAILURE_PENDING_CLEANUP, IA13-IA15 cannot apply without their earlier attempt-local states, and IA16/IA17 are not cancellation allowlist rows. Even if IA16 were inferred to remain legal, IA17's fixed CLEANING>FAILED projection conflicts with cancellation priority 5, which keeps the parent canonical CLEANING.

IX04 rejects because the release attempt is nonterminal/live. The accepted cancellation can neither reach attempt-local CANCELLED nor parent CANCELLED. The same gap exists when IX01 wins after IA16 with release_attempt_state=CLEANING.
findings.impact: The closed plan contradicts its total IX01 eligibility and leaves a reachable accepted cancellation permanently stranded in parent CLEANING. It has no exact legal edge that settles the release attempt and therefore no legal IX04 terminal path.
findings.required_correction: Add an exact, mutually exclusive cancellation settlement/adoption partition for release_attempt_state=FAILURE_PENDING_CLEANUP and CLEANING. It must preserve or complete existing attempt-local cleanup without duplicating the parent CleanupManifest, produce an attempt-local terminal compatible with IX dominance, and leave IX04 as the sole parent CANCELLED owner. Add generated witnesses for IX01 immediately before and after IA16 and before IA17, including IX05 adoption, exact reducer projections, replay/CAS conflicts, no duplicate cleanup owner, and eventual IX04 only after both attempt-local and parent cleanup guards pass.
